Here, we wangt to group the data 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

csv_url=c("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wwy200311gy-sudo/stat628/refs/heads/main/acute_yield_data_fall_2026.csv")

data=read.csv(csv_url)

head(data)
```
we need compare different groups.

```{r}

data_clean <- data %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(as.character(year)),
    cultivar = toupper(trimws(as.character(cultivar))),
    intensity_group = toupper(trimws(as.character(intensity_group))),
    treatment = toupper(trimws(as.character(treatment)))
  )



data_mq <- data_clean %>%
  filter(cultivar == "MQ")

data_st <- data_clean %>%
  filter(cultivar == "ST")
```

calculate the mean in different groups
```{r}

mean_valid <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}


calculate_means <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(year, cultivar, intensity_group, treatment) %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        c(rotten_n, rotten_weight, healthy_n, healthy_weight),
        mean_valid,
        .names = "{.col}_mean"
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      year,
      cultivar,
      match(intensity_group, c("A", "B", "C", "D")),
      match(treatment, c("CONTROL", "OTC"))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      treatment = recode(
        treatment,
        CONTROL = "Control",
        OTC = "OTC"
      )
    )
}


# Add total mean count/weight and rotten percentages to each mean table.
add_totals_and_percentages <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      total_n_mean = rotten_n_mean + healthy_n_mean,
      total_weight_mean = rotten_weight_mean + healthy_weight_mean,
      rotten_n_pct = 100 * rotten_n_mean /
        if_else(!is.na(total_n_mean) & total_n_mean > 0,
                total_n_mean, NA_real_),
      rotten_weight_pct = 100 * rotten_weight_mean /
        if_else(!is.na(total_weight_mean) & total_weight_mean > 0,
                total_weight_mean, NA_real_)
    )
}

mq_means <- calculate_means(data_mq) %>% add_totals_and_percentages()
st_means <- calculate_means(data_st) %>% add_totals_and_percentages()


print(mq_means, n = Inf)
print(st_means, n = Inf)


write.csv(
  mq_means,
  "MQ_group_means.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

write.csv(
  st_means,
  "ST_group_means.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```



Each figure shows four mean outcomes for groups A-D. Control is blue and
OTC is orange. 

```{r prepare-comparison-plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
metric_columns <- c(
  "rotten_n_mean", "rotten_weight_mean",
  "healthy_n_mean", "healthy_weight_mean"
)
metric_labels <- c(
  "Rotten fruit count (berries)", "Rotten fruit weight (g)",
  "Healthy fruit count (berries)", "Healthy fruit weight (g)"
)

comparison_data <- bind_rows(mq_means, st_means) %>%
  mutate(
    intensity_group = factor(
      toupper(trimws(as.character(intensity_group))),
      levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D")
    ),
    treatment = factor(
      toupper(trimws(as.character(treatment))),
      levels = c("CONTROL", "OTC"),
      labels = c("Control", "OTC")
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(metric_columns),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "mean_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_columns, labels = metric_labels)
  )

comparison_limits <- comparison_data %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(
    upper = if (all(is.na(mean_value))) {
      1
    } else {
      max(1, max(mean_value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(intensity_group = factor("A", levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D")))

plot_comparison <- function(selected_year, selected_cultivar) {
  one_panel <- comparison_data %>%
    filter(year == selected_year, cultivar == selected_cultivar)

  ggplot(one_panel, aes(x = intensity_group, y = mean_value, fill = treatment)) +
    geom_blank(
      data = comparison_limits,
      aes(x = intensity_group, y = upper),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.76),
      width = 0.66,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(is.na(mean_value), NA_character_,
                         sprintf("%.1f", mean_value))),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.76),
      vjust = -0.45,
      size = 3.2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(Control = "blue", OTC = "orange"),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(selected_cultivar, selected_year),
      x = "Heat pulse group",
      y = "Mean",
      fill = NULL,
      caption = "Bars show means. Each outcome uses the same scale across all four figures."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.5, "lines"),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 18, 12, 12)
    )
}
```

### MQ 2024

```{r mq-2024-comparison, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, out.width='100%', fig.retina=2}
plot_comparison(2024, "MQ")
```

### MQ 2025

```{r mq-2025-comparison, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, out.width='100%', fig.retina=2}
plot_comparison(2025, "MQ")
```

### ST 2024

```{r st-2024-comparison, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, out.width='100%', fig.retina=2}

```

```{r st-2025-comparison, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, out.width='100%', fig.retina=2}

```


Total count and total weight are the sums of the rotten and healthy mean
values. Percentages are ratios of group means, rather than averages of
individual plot percentages. A missing or zero total produces NA.

```{r prepare-rotten-percentage-plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rotten_percentage_data <- bind_rows(mq_means, st_means) %>%
  mutate(
    intensity_group = factor(intensity_group, levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D")),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Control", "OTC"))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(rotten_n_pct, rotten_weight_pct),
    names_to = "percentage_type",
    values_to = "rotten_pct"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage_type = factor(
      percentage_type,
      levels = c("rotten_n_pct", "rotten_weight_pct"),
      labels = c("Rotten percentage by count", "Rotten percentage by weight")
    )
  )

percentage_upper <- if (all(is.na(rotten_percentage_data$rotten_pct))) {
  100
} else {
  min(100, max(10, ceiling(
    max(rotten_percentage_data$rotten_pct, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2 / 10
  ) * 10))
}

plot_rotten_percentage <- function(selected_year, selected_cultivar) {
  one <- rotten_percentage_data %>%
    filter(year == selected_year, cultivar == selected_cultivar)

  ggplot(one, aes(intensity_group, rotten_pct, fill = treatment)) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.76), width = 0.66, na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(is.na(rotten_pct), NA_character_,
                         sprintf("%.1f%%", rotten_pct))),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.76),
      vjust = -0.45, size = 3.3, na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ percentage_type, ncol = 2, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(Control = "blue", OTC = "orange"), drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, percentage_upper),
      labels = scales::label_number(suffix = "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(selected_cultivar, selected_year, "Rotten fruit percentages"),
      x = "Heat pulse group", y = "Rotten fruit (%)", fill = NULL,
      caption = "Percentages = rotten mean / total mean x 100. All panels use the same scale."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.5, "lines"),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 18, 12, 12)
    )
}
```

### MQ 2024 Rotten percentages

```{r mq-2024-rotten-percentage, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=5, out.width='100%', fig.retina=2}
plot_rotten_percentage(2024, "MQ")
```
